instructions.title: How to play
instructions.model: You aim and time. Your character runs.
instructions.intro: Your character automatically runs toward the ball. You decide when to swing and where the ball goes.
steps: Serve. When the screen says ‘Your serve,’ press Space or tap Swing on your phone. The serve goes diagonally across the net.
Watch the ring. Green = swing now. Yellow = almost there. Orange = let it bounce first.
Swing once. Press Space once per swing. Holding Space does not keep swinging.
Aim. Hold ← or → while you press Space to aim left or right.
instructions.whiff: Swinging when the ball is far away does nothing, and it doesn’t cost you a point. The character only hits when the ball is inside the ring.
instructions.legacyWatch: Time your swing. Press Swing when the ball is close to your character. You decide when to hit.
instructions.legacyWhiff: Swinging when the ball is far away doesn’t cost you a point. Your character can only hit a ball within reach.
instructions.legacyWhen: Your serve, or when the ball is close
instructions.lose: You lose the point if you:
faults: Hit the ball into the net or outside the court.
Let it bounce twice on your side.
Hit the serve or first return before it bounces.
Hit the ball before it bounces while standing in the kitchen (next to the net).
instructions.scoring: First to 11 wins, by 2 points. The point winner serves next.
instructions.phone: Tap Swing when the ring turns green. The button glows and buzzes when it is time. Drag Aim to steer. Short tap = medium shot. Hold and release = stronger shot. Swipe up on Swing = high lob.
instructions.phoneBasics: Drag Aim to steer. Short tap = medium shot. Hold and release = stronger shot. Swipe up on Swing = high lob. In motion mode, tilt to aim and swing to hit.
controls: When the ring is green, or on your serve
At the moment of the swing
